source_message.text: The keywords centered on energy, confidence, stamina and performance are generic terms that we do not use, because using them makes the cpl too high, as I also told you last time. Please use keywords such as timing and dheelapan. Review the transcript from my winning video and the last reference I shared, then identify and write the keywords and send them here. The ones you have currently written—Energy, confidence, stamina—definitely do not work. You must also send the entire script in Hindi only.
